title: Trevis Portfolio
summary: A personal portfolio site built with Vite to present professional background, project work, and case-study content in a release-ready single-page application.
description: Trevis Portfolio is a personal portfolio application owned by TrevisCleary and built with Vite. The project is currently in Release Readiness with a running primary application service and a remediation set focused on governance, documentation, route validation, and public-launch preparation. Recent work includes adding route and asset smoke tests, updating the README for current routes and project structure, reconciling case-study routing cleanup, and documenting a repeatable intake-to-case-study promotion workflow. Remaining review items include owner-only security/content validation, production deployment verification, Vercel Deployment Protection handling, and final public review of resume, contact, screenshots, and case-study claims.
nextAction: Commit the current remediation set, resolve owner-only security/content review items, and disable or intentionally bypass Vercel Deployment Protection before public launch validation.
